subject: SIG intake & onboarding roadmap for CyberNova - control crosswalk and artifacts
messages:
From: Alice McIntyre <alice.mcintyre@cybernova.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@cybernova.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG questionnaire + onboarding plan for Redwood

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — CyberNova's security and procurement teams are aligned to kick off the SIG/RFI intake for Redwood as part of our vendor due diligence. Our target is to complete the questionnaire and have artifact substantiation in place before the procurement committee meets on July 2.

Can you confirm the following:
- A single point of contact for control crosswalk questions and artifact delivery
- Expected timeline for returning the completed SIG and a list of representative artifacts (SOC2 reports, config snapshots, KMS attestations, runbooks)
- Preferred mechanism for secure artifact transfer (SFTP/secure Drive/Box/DocuSign)

We'd like to schedule a 30-min intake call with your security lead and our assurance manager on Thursday or Friday this week. Proposed attendees: me, our procurement lead (procurement@cybernova.com), and CyberNova assurance manager (to be named).

Also: please highlight any areas in your SIG where you anticipate needing clarifications or where you will provide substitute evidence (e.g., architecture diagrams + screenshots rather than full logs).

Thanks,
Alice McIntyre
Vendor Risk & Procurement
CyberNova Solutions

---
Attachments referenced: (none in this initial message)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice McIntyre <alice.mcintyre@cybernova.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com, monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + onboarding plan for Redwood

Hi Alice — great to meet you in the intro. Thanks for the clear timeline.

High-level answers up front:
- POC: Evelyn Hart (Security & Assurance lead) — I will own the SIG crosswalk and coordinate artifact collection. I'll loop in Markus (platform) and Monica (customer ops) for artifact sourcing and upload logistics.
- Timeline: we can return a completed high-confidence SIG crosswalk within 5 business days of the intake call; artifact substantiation (packaged representative evidence) typically arrives within 7–10 business days depending on access to tenant-level artifacts. If CyberNova needs an accelerated path we can scope a partial submission (SOC2 + critical control screenshots) in 3–4 business days.
- Transfer method: we prefer a secure Google Drive share with restricted editors + viewer links for external reviewers and a one-time password-protected zip for sensitive exports. DocuSign/secure links can be used for signed attestations.

I'm available for the intake call Friday 10:00–11:00 AM ET. If that works, we will send a calendar invite and an intake agenda that includes: control owners mapping, evidence inventory, and pull-window for tenant-level extracts.

Markus will attach our SIG crosswalk template and a short guidance PDF with best-practice artifact examples. Monica will include upload instructions for your team.

Regards,

Evelyn Hart
Security & Assurance Lead
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com | M: (415) 555-0192

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 13:12, Alice McIntyre <alice.mcintyre@cybernova.com> wrote:
> Hi Evelyn,
> 
> Thanks for the quick intro earlier — CyberNova's security and procurement teams are aligned to kick off the SIG/RFI intake for Redwood as part of our vendor due diligence.

Thanks, Alice. A few practical notes from the platform side to make the artifact collection smoother: 

- Tenant-level exports: for evidence that requires tenant data (audit logs, access lists), we will provide obfuscated screenshots and aggregated logs where possible. For full raw logs we will coordinate an agreed pull-window and provide a redacted archive over the secure Drive link.
- KMS and key management: our KMS provider has a standard attestation bundle. We will include key rotation policy excerpts and HSM proof-of-ownership statements where applicable.
- Architecture diagrams: newest architecture diagrams (v2.4) will be included; if CyberNova needs sequence-level flow for data residency we can produce an annotated diagram for the SOC2 control owners.

Action items for the intake call:
1) Confirm CyberNova POC and attendee list
2) Agree on artifacts that must be produced prior to procurement review
3) Decide on a single secure folder where Redwood uploads artifacts and CyberNova reviewers get access

I'll step through the crosswalk on the call and mark any controls that typically require substitute evidence. Thanks and see you on Friday if that works.

-Markus

Markus Klein
Principal Platform Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Markus — thanks, this is helpful. Friday 10:00 AM ET works for the intake call. I'll confirm our assurance manager and invite details by EOD.

We will aim to upload an initial artifact packet (high-level SOC2 summary + representative screenshots) by Friday COB (June 18) to the Drive link you provide. Procurement's goal is to have a completed crosswalk and artifact set for the committee review on July 2.

Couple quick asks: can you flag in the template any controls where Redwood historically provides substitute evidence (e.g., policy excerpts + screenshots instead of raw logs)? That will help our assurance manager triage.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Alice McIntyre
Vendor Risk & Procurement
CyberNova Solutions
